def max_juice(n, actions):
    dp = [0] * n
    last_actions = [''] * 3
    
    for i in range(1, len(actions)):
        current_action = actions[i]
        if current_action == 'b':
            dp[i % n] += 1
        
        last_actions.pop(0)
        last_actions.append(current_action)
        
        if i >= 3 and last_actions[0] == last_actions[1] == last_actions[2]:
            dp[(i + 1) % n] -= 1
    
    return max(dp)
